ext.connect.title: Xhuma leli siphequluli
ext.connect.sub: Amawebhusayithi akhombiswa kulesi siphequluli abalwa ku-akhawunti yakho ye-PR.SOCIAL. Ukuxhuma kuthatha ukucindezela kanye kuwebhusayithi.
ext.connect.wait: Qinisekisa ukuxhumeka ekhasini elivuliwe. Ikhodi isasebenza {time}.
ext.connect.fail: Alukho uxhumo ku-pr.social. Hlola i-inthanethi bese uzama futhi.
ext.connect.no.tasks: Isiphequluli singaxhunywa ngemva kwemisebenzi evunyiwe engu-{need} noma ngaphezulu. Yenza imisebenzi ku-pr.social, bese uqinisekisa ukuxhuma futhi.
ext.connect.no.devices: I-akhawunti yakho isivele inamadivayisi axhunyiwe angu-{max}. Nqamula elinye ku-pr.social ku-Amathuluzi, bese uqinisekisa ukuxhuma futhi.
ext.connect.no.device: Leli siphequluli alikwazi ukuxhunywa. Iziphequluli ezilawulwa uhlelo azisekelwa.
ext.connect.no.restricted: I-akhawunti yakho ikhawulelwe. Isiphequluli sizoxhunywa uma ukukhawulelwa sesususwe.
ext.connect.no.off: Ukwelulwa kokuphequlula akukatholakali ku-akhawunti yakho okwamanje.
ext.start.hint: Amawebhusayithi avulelwa ewindini lawo. Gcina ukuthi lisesikrinini: ungalincisha, uyibeke ekhoneni bese usebenza kwamanye amawindi. Uma lincishiwe noma limbozwe ngokuphelele ngamanye amawindi, ukubonisa kuyama.
ext.perm.why: Ukuze kukhombiswe amawebhusayithi, ukwelulwa kucela i-Chrome imvume yokuvula noma yiliphi iwebhusayithi ewindini layo. Imvume le ayisetshenziswa nganoma yini enye.
ext.pause.hidden.sub: Ukukhombisa kuzoqhubeka uma iwindi lamawebhusayithi libuyela esikrinini.
ext.pause.locked.sub: Ukukhombisa kuzoqhubeka ngokuzenzakalela uma ikhompyutha ivulwa.
ext.gate.blocked.sub: I-PR.SOCIAL ivimbele leli siphequluli. Bhalela usizo: bazokuchazela isizathu nokuthi kufanele wenzeni.
ext.gate.update.sub: Uhlelo lwamanje alusasebenzi. Inkinobho ngezansi izovula ikhasi lenguqulo entsha futhi ibonise indlela yokuyifaka.
ext.gate.closed.sub: Ukwelulwa kuhlola ngokwako, ngakho akudingeki wenze lutho.
ext.off.sub: Lisusiwe ku-akhawunti yakho ku-pr.social. Ungalixhuma futhi ngekhodi elisha.
ext.limits.hour.hint: Amawebhusayithi angaki lesi siphequluli esingawakhombisa ngehora
ext.money: Okuholiwe kwakho kufika kubhalansi phakathi nemizuzu embalwa. Lapha kuyabonakala ngokushesha.
ext.stage.title: Iwindi le-PR Surf
ext.stage.sub: Amawebhusayithi avula lapha zodwa. Gcina le windi isendaweni ebonakalayo: ungayinciphisa, uyibeke ekhoneni bese usebenza kwamanye amawindi. Uma inciphisiwe noma imbozwe ngokuphelele, iyamisa. Ungayimisa esandiseni.
ext.wait.offline.sub: Ukukhonjiswa kuzoqhubeka ngokwayo uma uxhumo lubuya. Izindawo ezikhonjisiwe ngaphambili aziphulukiswa.
ext.wait.empty.sub: Izindawo ezintsha ziyavela lapho abakhangisi beoda izivakashi. Ukwandiswa kuzohlola futhi ngokwayo ngo-{time}.
ext.pause.closed.sub: Ukukhonjiswa kumisiwe kuze kuvulwe kabusha iwindi. Izindawo ezikhonjisiwe ngaphambili aziphulukiswa.
ext.pause.covered.sub: Izindawo zibalwa kuphela uma iwindi lazo libonakala. Ukukhonjiswa kuzoqhubeka uma libuya esikrinini.
ext.pause.check_missed.sub: Umbuzo “Ukhona?” awuphendulwanga ngesikhathi. Cindezela Qhubeka ukuze uqhubeke nokukhonjiswa.
ext.check.sub: Cindezela inkinobho engezansi ukuze uqhubeke. Ukukhonjiswa kumisiwe uze uphendule.
ext.stopped.restart: Ukukhonjiswa kumile lapho i-Chrome iqalisa kabusha. Qala futhi uma usulungele.
ext.net.stale: Alukho uxhumo ku-pr.social. Izinombolo ezingezansi zingase zibe ngaphambili.
ext.why.CRASH: Ikhasi liyekile ukuphendula, ngakho ukwandiswa kuvule ithebhu entsha kwaqhubeka.
ext.why.SHORT: Ikhasi belingekho esikrinini isikhathi eside ngokwanele. Gcina iwindi lezindawo livulekile futhi libonakala.
ext.why.EARLY: Ukwandiswa kubike le ndawo ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokubukwa kwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi usuku nesikhathi kwikhompyutha yakho kusethwa ngokuzenzakalela.
ext.why.GONE: Ukwandiswa kubike le ndawo ngemva kwesikhathi: ukukhonjiswa kuphazamisekile isikhathi eside.
ext.why.BLOCKED: Ukuvikelwa kwesayithi akuvumelanga ukwandiswa ukuthi kuvule ikhasi.
ext.why.TIMEOUT: Isayithi lithathe isikhathi eside ukulayisha. Mhlawumbe lihamba kancane, noma uxhumo lubuthakathaka.
ext.update.ready: Kukhona inguqulo entsha ye-PR Surf. Le nguqulo isaqhubeka nokusebenza okwamanje.
